repositoryGroups.hint.en: Select one or more groups. Repositories with no groups appear at the root.
repositoryGroups.hint.zh-CN: 可以选择多个分组。不选择任何分组时，仓库显示在根层。

repositoryGroups.mixedHint.en: A mixed checkbox means some selected repositories belong to the group. Only changed groups will be applied.
repositoryGroups.mixedHint.zh-CN: 半选表示部分仓库属于该分组。只应用修改过的分组勾选，其他归属保持不变。
repositoryGroups.mixedHint.context: Repository group membership management and drag-and-drop

repositoryGroups.empty.en: No groups yet. Create a group using Add in Repositories.
repositoryGroups.empty.zh-CN: 还没有分组，请通过仓库列表的添加入口创建分组。

repositoryGroups.noMatches.context: Repository group membership management and drag-and-drop

repositoryGroups.sourceChanged.en: The source group membership has changed. Refresh the repository list and try again.
repositoryGroups.sourceChanged.zh-CN: 来源分组关系已变化，请刷新仓库列表后重试。
repositoryGroups.sourceChanged.context: Repository group membership management and drag-and-drop

repositoryGroups.deleteGroup.en: Delete repository group "{{name}}"? Repositories in other groups stay there; those with no remaining groups return to the root.
repositoryGroups.deleteGroup.zh-CN: 删除仓库分组“{{name}}”？仓库保留其他分组归属，没有其他分组的仓库回到根层。
repositoryGroups.deleteGroup.context: Repository group membership management and drag-and-drop

repositoryGroups.dragHint.en: Drag to move or reorder. Alt+Up/Down reorders within this level.
repositoryGroups.dragHint.zh-CN: 拖动以移动或排序；Alt+上/下键在当前层级排序。

repositoryGroups.moveToRoot.en: Move to root and leave all groups
repositoryGroups.moveToRoot.zh-CN: 移到根层，并退出所有分组

repositoryGroups.rootDrop.en: Drop here to move to the root and leave all groups
repositoryGroups.rootDrop.zh-CN: 拖到此处移至根层，并退出所有分组
